senses.gloss:
‘katakayogīndra’
a.'s real name not known.
--C. Amṛtakataka or Kataka on Rāmāyaṇa of Vālmīki. TD. 9356.

‘katipayadhātavah2’
gr. by Gaṅgādhara. Nepal II. p. 115. Its correct name is probably Śabdamālā. C.. kriyate zabdamAlaiSA gaGgAdhareNa dhImatA.

‘katipayakārakavyākhyāna’
gr. by Vidyāsāgara. Hpr. II. 27. See below under Kātantra, a.'s C. on Trilocana's Pañjikā on Durgasiṁha's C.

‘kathākośa’
Śukasaptati is assigned to it. See IO. ii. p. 1194b.

‘kanakākhyaprayoga’
one of the 64 tantras mentioned in Śivatattvaratnākara, p. 4. Madras edn., 1927.

‘kamalaśīlatarka’
a name in some mss. for Kamalaśīla's C. on Tattvasaṅgraha.

‘kamalākaraśreṣṭhikathā’
Jain. IO. 7685.

‘kamalālayamāhātmya’
or Kaliviḍambana, a complaint addressed to King Śāhaji of Tanjore (1684-1710 A. D.) about the corruption of the officers a. the elephant stables of the Tanjore kings a. Tiruvārūr. TD. 4239 (See Col.).

‘karaṇaparatilaka’
jy. by Bhānuyaśas (?) mentioned in Sachau, Alberuni's India, I. p. 157. For a. discussion on it see Bhāratīya Jyotiṣa, (Hindi), p. 329.

‘karatalaratna’
Bud. ascribed to Bhāvaviveka or Bhavya. Nanjio 1237 (Mahāyāna-tālaratna-sūtra).
Ed.. with Intro. & Summary an. English transl. of Chinese version, Viśvabhāratī Studies 9. 1949.

‘karṇāmṛtakavi’
mentioned in Intro. verse 12 of Gaṅgādevī's Madhurāvijaya. This is Kṛṣṇalīlāśuka, a. of Kṛṣṇakarṇāmṛta.

‘karṇārjunīya’
campū. a prabandha for the Cākyār Kūttu of Kerala. MT. 5267.

‘kartṛkarmabhāvaprayoga’_(?)
America 3399.

‘kartṛviparyayavicāra’
by Tryaṁbaka Śarman. Harshe 66 (ms. d. 1853 A. D.) (from a.'s C. on Gṛhyapariśiṣṭakārikā.)

‘karman’
Bud. (?) of the ‘Dharmaguptanikāya.’ [Page200-a. (Chin. transl. 220-65 A. D.). Nanjio 1146.

‘karmasaraṇi’
or Āhnikapaddhati. dh. See Yajurvallabhā by Viṭṭhala Dīkṣita, Baroda 6890. L. 2061, intro. verse 2.
--A name also of Yajurvallabhā by Keśavajit, son of Viśvanatha. RASB. II. 1186 (Col.).

‘kalilakṣaṇa’
conjectural title. Dacca 455. G. (inc.).

‘kalpa’
(Vāstupraveśa etc.). dh. jy. RASB. III. 2606 (VI).

‘kalpanāpoḍhavādavyākhyā’
ny. Triv. Cur. VII. 39.

‘kalpasaṅgraha’
med. collection of med. Kalpas on Aśvagandhā, Musalī an. Vijayā. Same a. Aśvagandhāmusalīvijayākalpa, NCC. I. p. 319a. BORI. D. XVI. i. 40.

‘kalpita-māhātmya-anantanāgagrāmāṇām’
paur. compiled by order of King Raṇavīrasiṁha of Kashmir. IIO. Stein 242.

‘kalyāṇaṃ_Śrīnṛsiṃha’_Iti_Ślokasya_Vyākhyā
Paliyam 22. 95 (c).

‘kalyāṇanām’_Iti_Ślokavyākhyā
Mysore I. p. 212.

‘kavikarṇapūra’
by Kavikaṛṇapūra. SSPC. III. E. 58 (inc.). Some work of Kavikarṇapūra Paramānanda ?

‘kavikāvyagarbhacakra’
also called Jīvaśataka an. Stutividyā. Jain. 116 stanzas. by Samantabhadra. BP. p. 208b. CPB. 7093-5 (ascribed to Śāntivarman in CPB. 7093-4).

‘kavikulatilaka’
--Prasaṅgābharaṇa. anthology ptd. in Grantharatnamālā, (Gopal Narayan C.., Bombay) Vol. IV. p.. 1-30. [Page273-a.
The last col. like verse mentions some names which seem to refer to the a. an. his father, but it is not clear. The work is mainly a condensation of the larger anthology Prasaṅgābharaṇa, MT. 1580 an. 2539 (a..

‘kavitāvicāra’
alaṁk. in 20 verses. a.. on dhvani. Firenze 449.

‘kavivacanasamuccaya’
Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p.. 20-21. See ‘Kavīndravacanasamuccaya’.

‘kavīndravacanasamuccaya’
tentative title of a fragment ed. in Bib. Ind. by F. W. Thomas, of the Subhāṣitaratnakośa of Vidyākara.
RASB. VII. 5439 (inc.).
Full text ed. D. D. Kosambi an. V. V. Gokhale. HOS. 42. 1957.

‘kasyācit’_(?)_Ityasyopari_Lekha
on a verse in Bhāgavatapurāṇa. Udaipur II. 94, 1, 75.

‘kākarudrasaṃvāda’
augury. Oxf. 338a. C.. Kākaruta ascribed to Garga, Bomb. Uni. 510. Common lines are found in these two mss.

‘kātyāyanamatasaṅgraha’
See below Kāty. smṛti.

‘kātyāyanīyamantrakhaṇḍavyākhyā’
(fr.) identity not clear; mantras of Sandhyā, Puruṣasūkta etc. explained. RASB. II. 841.

‘kādikṣāntaślokāh2’
anthology of subhāṣitas alphabetically arranged. GD. 1693 (inc.). Granthappura p. 83 (no. 1693).

‘kāntaste’
Sangam 33 f. See Catuśślokī of Yāmuna, of which this is the opening verse.

‘kāntonaṣaṣṭikā-ekonaṣaṣṭi’_(?)
Deo 298.

‘kāmatah2_Strīvadhe_Prāyaścittanirṇaya’
dh. by Vāsudevāśramamuni. Harshe p. 42.

‘kāmadevavijaya’
gr. a tract criticising the views of a scholar named Kāmadeva. by Someśvara Dīkṣita of Tanjore. ref. in Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa's Apāṇinīyaprāmāṇyasādhana or Parapakṣakhaṇḍana.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 254a.

‘kāmaśāstra’
Q. in Pūrṇasarasvatī's C. on Mālatīmādhava, TSS. 170. p.. 57. 117.
The two qs. here are from Ratirahasya.

‘kāmaśāstra’
(ms. from Tibet). JBORS. XXIII. i. p. 41 (inc.).

‘kāmaśāstra’
fr. of some work on Kāmaśāstra. Nepal I. p. 82 (fr., 5 leaves).

‘kāyene’tipādma(ºśloka),_ºvivaraṇa
vallabhīya. C. on Bhāgavata XI. 2. 36 by Viṭṭhaleśvara. Hall p. 151. Udaipur II. 129, 72 (c). 134, 1 (70).

‘kārakavicāra’
gr. Saṁkṣiptasāra. RASB. VI. 4502.

‘kārakavicāra’
BORI. 49 of 1874-75. Same a. Uktiratnākara of Sādhusundaragaṇi. See BORI. D. II. i. 386 an. NCC. II. p. 281b.

‘kārikā’
see IO. 2676 (I. p. 940a). Śivadāsasena in his C. on Cakrapāṇidatta's Saṁgraha mentions this a. one of the three texts ref. to in the expression ‘Bhaṭṭatraya’ in the last verse in Cakradatta's Saṁgraha; seems to be the same a. Kumārila's Ślokavārttika.

‘kāruṇikarājaprajñāpāramitādhāraṇīvyākhyā’
Bud. Nanjio 1406. C.. also Nanjio 17, 965, 1419, ‘Pr. [Page385-b] p.. sūtra on the benevolent king who protects his country’.

‘kāruṇikarājaprajñāpāramitādhyāyakalpa’
Bud. Nanjio 1419.
C.. ibid. 965, 1406 an. 1417.

‘kāruṇikarājarāṣṭrapālaprajñāpāramitāsūtrabodhimaṇḍādhyāyakalpa’_
Bud. Nanjio 1435.
C.. ibid. 965, 1406, 1417, 1419.

‘kālacakravākya(kā._Cakrādarśa)’_(?)
jy. IO. 6435.

‘kālacakrādarśa(kālacakravākya)’_(?)
jy. IO. 6435. Mack. 124.

‘kāladīpaka’
jy. MT. 5236 (with Mal. C.) (inc.). Different from the text by Śaṅkara.

‘kālamīmāṃsā’
by Mādhavācārya. Deo 21.
See Kālanirṇaya.

‘kālahastīśvarapraśaṃsā’
from Śivarahasya. Adyar I. p. 142b (inc.). See under Kā. māhātmya.

‘kāśīsetu’
the section on Kāśī in Tristhalīsetu of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. IM. 2757. 2951. [Page142-b]

‘kāśyapīyaroganidāna’
med. spoken by Kāśyapa according to the last verse. MD. 13112 (inc.).
